title: Helper function has the same name as a public #[near] method (wasm-only build error)
summary: #[near] exports every public method of a contract impl as a wasm entry point with the same name, so a free function with that name in the same module collides (E0428). The host build used by `cargo test` does not generate those exports, so unit tests still pass and the error only appears when building for wasm.
message: Free function `{name}` (line {line}) collides with the public #[near] method of the same name (line {methodLine}).

symptoms.pattern: error\[E0428\]: the name `(?<name>\w+)` is defined multiple times

steps: Rename the free helper function `{name}` to something that is not a public method name (for example a `compute_` prefix) and update its call sites.
Use `cargo near check` in your edit loop: it reports this in seconds, while `cargo test --lib` still passes with the bug present.
fix.agent: In {file} at line {line}, rename the free function `{name}` to `{newName}` (leave the #[near] method at line {methodLine} unchanged) and update its call sites. Then run `cargo near check`.

evidence.observed: Reproduced 2026-11-13 (macOS 15 arm64, rustc 1.100.0, cargo-near 0.23.0, near-sdk 5.30.1, node 26.12.1): with the clash, `cargo test --lib` passed 18/18 while the wasm build failed with E0428. `cargo near check` reported it in 8.5 s on a cold cache; the fixed control passed in 0.4 s.
